structured.answer: I understand it better now. You lock the money away for a set time and the bank pays fixed interest, minus 15% tax. Taking it out early can cost the interest and even some of what I put in, so next time I'll ask the clerk for a deposit with "תחנות יציאה" and what the penalty is. I'll also ask you about the "no deposit insurance" part and why 70,000 shows as 68,270.

stuck.why: Big number 68,270 ₪ next to 'ההפקדות שלכם 70,000 ₪': looks like I end up with less than I put in. I didn't understand the 'בכסף של היום' / 'בשקלים של העתיד' buttons.
It says the site doesn't calculate the early-break penalty, so I never found out how much breaking a deposit costs.
Frightened me. I thought a deposit was completely safe.

findings.what: The first big number (68,270) is smaller than the 70,000 deposited, with no plain sentence saying why. It looks like losing money on a deposit.
'אין ביטוח פיקדונות' is alarming and not explained near the top
The cost of breaking a deposit is never given. The site says it doesn't calculate it.
